continue.description: Load project context, alignment audit, status check, suggest next action. Auto-invoke at session start, after context switches, or when user says 'continue', 'resume', 'what's next', 'status check'.

done.description: Self-evolving session completion: validate, sync, heal, evolve, report, commit. Auto-invoke when user says 'done', 'finished', 'wrap up', 'commit this', 'push it', 'ship it'.

piv.description: Self-recursive development loop: research, plan, execute, validate, heal, repeat. Auto-invoke when user says 'piv', 'autopilot', 'ship it', 'full validation', 'keep going until done'.

kino-analyze.description: Analyze a video script or transcript — extract beats, concepts, emotional arc, and visual metaphor opportunities. Use when the user provides a script, transcript, or video brief.

kino-spec.description: Write a production spec — the creative contract defining beat map, color arc, visual philosophy, key moments, persistent elements, and audio sync. Use after /kino-analyze, before /kino-build.

kino-build.description: Build and render a kino video from a production spec. Generates SceneComposition v2.0 JSON, renders via kino CLI. Use after /kino-spec.
